t.Setenv("TS_VERIFY_LIVE", "")
	for _, test := range []struct {
		args      []string
		want      string
		wantError bool
	}{
		{args: []string{"--help"}, want: "Usage: ts-orch"},
		{args: []string{"verify", "--help"}, want: "opt in"},
		{args: []string{"verify"}, want: "requires --live", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"log-scan", "--help"}, want: "--fly-app"},
		{args: []string{"dashboard", "--help"}, want: "three observed controllers"},
		{args: []string{"dashboard", "check"}, want: "requires --gru-token-file", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"cost"}, want: "Usage: ts-orch cost report"},
		{args: []string{"cost", "report"}, want: "needs --region", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"network", "--help"}, want: "--all"},
		{args: []string{"network", "check", "unexpected"}, want: "no positional arguments", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"bootstrap", "--help"}, want: "sign-anchor"},
		{args: []string{"release", "--help"}, want: "sign-binary"},
		{args: []string{"image", "--help"}, want: "build-offline"},
		{args: []string{"netbird", "--help"}, want: "install"},
		{args: []string{"netbird", "path-audit", "--help"}, want: "--expected-ip"},
		{args: []string{"netbird", "path-audit"}, want: "requires --vault-id", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"netbird", "sync", "--help"}, want: "prune-peers"},
		{args: []string{"netbird", "inventory", "unexpected"}, want: "no positional arguments", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"oci-region", "--help"}, want: "preview"},
		{args: []string{"oci-region", "import-image", "--help"}, want: `unknown oci-region command "import-image"`, wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"oci-region", "import-image", "--qcow2", "candidate.qcow2", "--sha256", strings.Repeat("a", 64)}, want: `unknown oci-region command "import-image"`, wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"qualification", "--help"}, want: "firecracker"},
		{args: []string{"qualification", "firecracker", "--help"}, want: "prepare-base"},
		{args: []string{"runtime-priority", "--help"}, want: "probe-admission"},
		{args: []string{"ouroboros", "--help"}, want: "fly-secrets"},
		{args: []string{"vault", "--help"}, want: "render"},
		{args: []string{"disaster-recovery", "--help"}, want: "does not rebuild"},
		{args: []string{"disaster-recovery", "replicate"}, want: "requires --config", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"disaster-recovery", "drill"}, want: "unknown disaster-recovery command", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"vault", "put"}, want: "put requires", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"ouroboros", "fly-secrets"}, want: "fly-secrets requires", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"bootstrap", "verify-anchor"}, want: "verify-anchor requires", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"release", "publish"}, want: "publish requires", wantError: true},
		{args: []string{"misspelled"}, want: "unknown command", wantError: true},
	} {
		t.Run(strings.Join(test.args, " "), func(t *testing.T) {
			var output bytes.Buffer
			err := Run(t.Context(), test.args, &output)
			if test.wantError {
				if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), test.want) {
					t.Fatalf("error = %v, want %q", err, test.want)
				}
				if output.Len() != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("failed command wrote data: %q", output.String())
				}
			} else if err != nil || !strings.Contains(output.String(), test.want) {
				t.Fatalf("output = %q, error = %v", output.String(), err)
			}
		})
	}

func TestStreamRaisesToastsForNewInsights(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	dashboard, source, _ := journalDashboard(Options{Interval: time.Hour})
	server := newStreamServer(t, dashboard)
	reader, _ := openStream(t, server, "/insights/stream")
	reader.next()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
	for source.subscribed() == 0 && time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}

func TestJournalRunRetriesThenDrops(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &fakeSink{failures: 2}
	journal := NewJournal(JournalConfig{Region: "gru", Sink: sink})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	go func() { _ = journal.Run(ctx) }()
	journal.Record(t.Context(), Decision{Kind: KindHeld})
	waitFor(t, func() bool { return sink.count() == 1 })
	if stats := journal.Stats(); stats.Published != 1 || stats.PublishFailed != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stats = %+v", stats)
	}
	sink.mu.Lock()
	sink.failures = publishAttempts
	sink.mu.Unlock()
	journal.Record(t.Context(), Decision{Kind: KindHeld})
	waitFor(t, func() bool { return journal.Stats().PublishFailed == 1 })
}

func TestMissingHostRegistrationGetsNoSignedReply(t *testing.T) {
	c, conn, _, mutations, controllerKey := testController(t)
	hostKey := registerTestHost(t, c)
	controllerCtx, stopController := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer stopController()
	controllerDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { controllerDone <- c.Run(controllerCtx) }()
	select {
	case <-c.Ready():
	case <-t.Context().Done():
		t.Fatal(t.Context().Err())
	}
	agent, err := NewAgent(AgentConfig{
		NATSUserPublicKey:   testNATSUserKey("node-a"),
		ClockCheck:          func() error { return nil },
		WorkloadIdentity:    testAgentIdentity(),
		Cell:                "gru",
		Node:                "node-a",
		Environment:         "production",
		Roles:               []string{"terrabase"},
		Conn:                conn,
		Identity:            hostKey,
		ControllerPublicKey: controllerKey.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey),
		Runner:              &memoryRunner{observed: make(map[string]Observation)},
		InstallRoot:         testAgentInstallRoot(t),
		StateRoot:           testAgentStateRoot(t),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := agent.acquire(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("acquire before registration removal: %v", err)
	}
	mutations.mu.Lock()
	delete(mutations.entries, mutations.key(authority.MutationRegistration, registrationSubjectKey("gru", "node-a")))
	mutations.mu.Unlock()
	requestCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	if err := agent.acquire(requestCtx); !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("missing registration received a signed reply: %v", err)
	}
	stopController()
	<-controllerDone
}

agent, err := NewAgent(AgentConfig{NATSUserPublicKey: testNATSUserKey(cfg.Node), Cell: "gru", Node: cfg.Node, Environment: "production", Roles: []string{"terrabase"},
		Conn: conn, Identity: hostKey, ControllerPublicKey: controllerKey.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey),
		InstallRoot: filepath.Join(stateRoot, "install"), StateRoot: filepath.Join(stateRoot, "state"),
		ManagedRuntimeRoot: "/srv/ts-managed", BakedSystemReserveBytes: cfg.SystemReserveBytes,
		ManagedS3Credentials: s3Credentials,
		WorkloadIdentity:     WorkloadIdentity{UID: 65534, GID: 65534},
		PollInterval:         250 * time.Millisecond, ClockCheck: func() error { return nil }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create native host agent: %v", err)
	}
	agentCtx, stopAgent := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer stopAgent()
	agentDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { agentDone <- agent.Run(agentCtx) }()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(120 * time.Second)
	var report Report
	var lastReports []Report
	var lastHostError error
	var lastHostCount int
	var lastHostVerified bool
	var lastSessionExpiry time.Time
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		select {
		case err := <-agentDone:
			t.Fatalf("native agent stopped before running report: %v", err)
		default:
		}
		hosts, err := controller.ListHosts(t.Context())
		lastHostError = err
		if err == nil {
			lastHostCount = len(hosts)
			if len(hosts) == 1 {
				lastHostVerified = hosts[0].Verified
				lastSessionExpiry = hosts[0].SessionExpiresAt
				lastReports = hosts[0].Reports
			}
		}
		if err == nil && len(hosts) == 1 && hosts[0].Verified && len(hosts[0].Reports) == 1 &&
			hosts[0].Reports[0].State == "running" && hosts[0].Reports[0].Managed != nil {
			report = hosts[0].Reports[0]
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(250 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if report.Managed == nil {
		t.Fatalf("no accepted signed managed running report within deadline: host count=%d verified=%t session expiry=%s; last host error: %v; last reports: %+v",
			lastHostCount, lastHostVerified, lastSessionExpiry.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), lastHostError, lastReports)
	}

stopAgent()
	select {
	case <-agentDone:
	case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("native agent did not stop")
	}
	fmt.Printf("TS_MANAGED_MEMBER_PHASE=PASS node=%s\n", cfg.Node)

checkpoint, key, roots, now := checkpointFixture(t)
	_, wire := issueCheckpoint(t, checkpoint, key, now)
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*CheckpointExpectation)
	}{
		{"operation", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.OperationID = entityid.Derive("other-operation") }},
		{"deployment", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.DeploymentID = entityid.Derive("other-deployment") }},
		{"cluster", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.ClusterID = entityid.Derive("other-cluster") }},
		{"environment", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Environment = "production" }},
		{"cell", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Cell = "SFO" }},
		{"slot", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Slot = "controller-b" }},
		{"unknown slot", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Slot = "controller-d" }},
		{"instance", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.InstanceOCID += "other" }},
		{"image", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.ImageOCID += "other" }},
		{"vnic", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.PrimaryVNICOCID += "other" }},
		{"ip", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.PrimaryPrivateIP = "10.251.0.99" }},
		{"binary digest", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Binary.SHA256 = sha256Hex([]byte("other")) }},
		{"binary size", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Binary.Size++ }},
		{"binary arch", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Binary.Architecture = "arm64" }},
		{"config digest", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.ConfigSHA256["controller.json"] = sha256Hex([]byte("other")) }},
		{"launch digest", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) {
			e.Slot.LaunchMaterialSHA256["operator-ssh-key.pub"] = sha256Hex([]byte("other"))
		}},
		{"config inventory", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { delete(e.Slot.ConfigSHA256, "placement.json") }},
		{"material generation", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.MaterialGenerationSHA256 = sha256Hex([]byte("other")) }},
		{"old exact bytes", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.PreviousAcceptanceSHA256 = sha256Hex([]byte("old\n")) }},
		{"store path", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Store.Directory += "-other" }},
		{"server name", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Store.ServerName += "-other" }},
		{"raft node", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Store.RaftNodeID = "OTHER001" }},
		{"server-name bytes", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Store.ServerNameSHA256 = sha256Hex([]byte("other")) }},
		{"node-identity bytes", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Slot.Store.NodeIdentitySHA256 = sha256Hex([]byte("other")) }},
		{"broker keys", func(e *CheckpointExpectation) { e.Broker.CellAccount = publicKey(t, false) }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			expected := expectation(checkpoint, checkpoint.Slots[0])
			test.mutate(&expected)
			if _, err := VerifyAcceptedIdentityCheckpoint(wire, roots, trust.RootChain{Version: 1}, expected, now); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("accepted a different independently observed binding")
			}
		})
	}

func TestOIDCNeverRequestsWritingRoutesOrSendsCredentials(t *testing.T) {
	clearVerifyEnv(t)
	t.Setenv("TS_VERIFY_OIDC_JWT", "existing-user-jwt-must-not-be-sent")
	t.Setenv("E2E_MANAGEMENT_CREDENTIAL", "existing-service-secret-must-not-be-sent")
	var trapCalls atomic.Int32
	trap := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) { trapCalls.Add(1) }))
	defer trap.Close()
	for _, attack := range []string{"valid keys", "trailing issuer slash", "writing readiness", "writing Management", "off origin", "credentials", "query", "empty query", "fragment", "encoded readiness", "relative", "wrong issuer", "discovery redirect", "JWKS redirect", "empty keys", "malformed keys"} {
		t.Run(attack, func(t *testing.T) {
			var origin string
			var keyCalls atomic.Int32
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				if r.Method != http.MethodGet || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "" || r.Header.Get("Cookie") != "" {
					t.Errorf("unsafe request method/credentials")
				}
				if r.URL.Path == "/.well-known/jwks.json" {
					keyCalls.Add(1)
					switch attack {
					case "JWKS redirect":
						http.Redirect(w, r, trap.URL+"/readyz", http.StatusFound)
					case "empty keys":
						io.WriteString(w, `{"keys":[]}`)
					case "malformed keys":
						io.WriteString(w, `{`)
					default:
						io.WriteString(w, `{"keys":[{"kid":"retrieved-only"}]}`)
					}
					return
				}
				if r.URL.Path != "/.well-known/openid-configuration" {
					t.Errorf("fetched writing/unreviewed path %s", r.URL.Path)
					w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
					return
				}
				issuer, uri := origin, origin+"/.well-known/jwks.json"
				switch attack {
				case "trailing issuer slash":
					issuer += "/"
				case "writing readiness":
					uri = origin + "/readyz"
				case "writing Management":
					uri = origin + "/v1/management/organizations"
				case "off origin":
					uri = trap.URL + "/.well-known/jwks.json"
				case "credentials":
					uri = strings.Replace(uri, "http://", "http://user:secret@", 1)
				case "query":
					uri += "?write=true"
				case "empty query":
					uri += "?"
				case "fragment":
					uri += "#fragment"
				case "encoded readiness":
					uri = origin + "/%72eadyz"
				case "relative":
					uri = "/.well-known/jwks.json"
				case "wrong issuer":
					issuer = trap.URL
				case "discovery redirect":
					http.Redirect(w, r, trap.URL+"/readyz", http.StatusFound)
					return
				}
				json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"issuer": issuer, "jwks_uri": uri})
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			origin = server.URL
			v := localVerifier(t)
			v.oidc(origin)
			want := "FAIL"
			if attack == "valid keys" || attack == "trailing issuer slash" {
				want = "PASS"
			}
			assertRow(t, v, "OIDC discovery/nonempty JWKS retrieved", want)
			assertRow(t, v, "5. TerraBase validates ts-auth user JWTs", "UNKNOWN")
			wantCalls := int32(0)
			if want == "PASS" || attack == "JWKS redirect" || attack == "empty keys" || attack == "malformed keys" {
				wantCalls = 1
			}
			if keyCalls.Load() != wantCalls || trapCalls.Load() != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("key requests=%d want=%d; unsafe requests=%d", keyCalls.Load(), wantCalls, trapCalls.Load())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestVerifierRejectsTokens(t *testing.T) {
	i := newIssuer(t)
	v := i.verifier()
	now := time.Now().Unix()
	valid := i.sign("skey_one", nil, nil)
	parts := strings.Split(valid, ".")
	forgedClaims, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"iss": testIssuer, "aud": testAudience, "sub": "0000000000FT4JKN5QV2BGQ38B",
		"scope": "orch:write", "exp": now + 3600})
	otherKey, _ := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
	cases := map[string]string{
		"payload swapped":    parts[0] + "." + base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(forgedClaims) + "." + parts[2],
		"signature flipped":  parts[0] + "." + parts[1] + "." + flipLast(parts[2]),
		"no signature":       parts[0] + "." + parts[1] + ".",
		"alg none":           i.sign("skey_one", map[string]any{"alg": "none"}, nil),
		"alg HS256":          i.sign("skey_one", map[string]any{"alg": "HS256"}, nil),
		"id token typ":       i.sign("skey_one", map[string]any{"typ": "JWT"}, nil),
		"no typ":             i.sign("skey_one", map[string]any{"typ": nil}, nil),
		"no kid":             i.sign("skey_one", map[string]any{"kid": nil}, nil),
		"other key same kid": signWith(otherKey, "skey_one", nil, nil),
		"unknown kid":        i.sign("skey_unknown", nil, nil),
		"wrong issuer":       i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"iss": "https://evil.example/terrascale"}),
		"issuer suffix":      i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"iss": testIssuer + "/"}),
		"wrong audience":     i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"aud": "https://gru.api.terrascale.tech"}),
		"audience prefix":    i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"aud": testAudience + "/"}),
		"no audience":        i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"aud": nil}),
		"expired":            i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"exp": now - 120}),
		"no exp":             i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"exp": nil}),
		"not yet valid":      i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"nbf": now + 600}),
		"issued in future":   i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"iat": now + 600}),
		"no subject":         i.sign("skey_one", nil, map[string]any{"sub": nil}),
		"two segments":       parts[0] + "." + parts[1],
		"oversized":          strings.Repeat("a", maxTokenBytes+1),
		"garbage header":     "!!!." + parts[1] + "." + parts[2],
	}
	for name, token := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := v.Verify(t.Context(), token)
			if !errors.Is(err, ErrUnauthenticated) {
				t.Fatalf("Verify = %v, want ErrUnauthenticated", err)
			}
		})
	}
}
